[[Johan Garham]] can be found patrolling near the [[Grenth]] [[shrine]] south of the [[Citadel of Dzagon]] in the [[Wilderness of Bahdza]], but don't count on him for any help.

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Wilderness of Bahdza}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Did you know when [[rain beetle]]s are newly hatched they are scrutinized by their mother? Any found to be imperfect, are cast out of the nest. Legend has it there is an island where these misfit bugs gather."''

==Trivia==
*This NPC is named after alpha tester John Graham, who was the leader of the Isle Of Misfits guild; hence the dialogue reference.
